name: Hassheret
title: Ancestor of the Temple Servants
summary: Hassheret (meaning 'the scribe') is mentioned in the lists of temple servants (Nethinim) who returned from the Babylonian exile to Jerusalem. The name appears in Ezra's and Nehemiah's lists of those who returned, representing a family or clan of temple servants who served in the rebuilt temple.

keyEvents.title: Listed among the Temple Servants Who Returned
keyEvents.description: Hassheret is mentioned among the descendants of Solomon's servants in the list of those who returned from Babylon to Jerusalem under Zerubbabel's leadership.

keyEvents.title: The Role of Temple Servants in the Rebuilt Temple
keyEvents.description: The descendants of Hassheret were among those who served in the temple after returning from exile, contributing to the restoration of worship in Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Counting Those Who Returned
keyEvents.description: Hassheret and his descendants were recorded in the official census of those who returned from the Babylonian exile, confirming their belonging to the temple service.

keyEvents.title: Part of the Descendants of Solomon's Servants
keyEvents.description: Hassophereth belonged to the group called 'The descendants of Solomon's servants', a special category of temple servants with roots going back to King Solomon's time.
